title: Update `load-config.mjs` to expose `shardLibraries`
description: Modify `scripts/load-config.mjs`. After existing config load, call `loadLibraries(configPath)` from `shard-library.mjs` and attach result as `config.shardLibraries`. Preserve legacy `config.tasksSource` for any other consumer that may read it. Document the new field in inline comments.
acceptance_criteria: Existing callers of `load-config.mjs` see no change in legacy fields
`config.shardLibraries` is always an array (length ≥ 1) after load
A config with neither `shardLibraries` nor `tasksSource.primary` throws a clear error
